about: Site profiles for the site-selection mode (docs/site-selection.md): what each structure type needs, broken into requirement primitives bound to layers, with every threshold typed LEGAL (cites the diploma and article; a human validates it before it is stated as fact) or TECHNICAL (engineering or planning rule of thumb, always presented as such). Data, not code: the engine that reads this file is written inside the build window. Companion of data/pretensoes.json (plot mode) — same conventions: status 'proposta' = not yet validated by the author; only 'validado' may be stated as fact. Nothing here decides a site; it says what is measured, what triggers which procedure and what cannot be assessed.

type.LEGAL: comes from a legal text; cite diploma + article; validated by the author before being stated as fact
type.TECHNICAL: engineering/planning rule of thumb or a published study's working value; always said as such

effect.exclude: the cell/footprint is out, with this rule's id (physical infeasibility — TECHNICAL only until the author validates a LEGAL one as absolute)
effect.procedure: measured and named with the procedure it triggers (hectares, diploma, who decides) — never a silent exclusion
effect.positive: zoning or designation that makes the use easier; ranks up, never excludes the rest
effect.score: TECHNICAL criterion scored 0–3 for ranking (Pareto layers, no hidden weighted sum)
effect.context: shown in the card, never ranks
effect.fact: true for every candidate of the type; stated once

legends.if_validated: effect the author may switch the rule to after validating it for that type (e.g. 'exclude' for a LEGAL interdiction on a school); until then the rule keeps 'effect'

verified.texto_oficial: article read in the official text (Diário da República PDF) on the date given
verified.texto_consolidado: article read in a consolidated text mirroring the DRE (FAOLEX, entity site, PGDL) on the date given — confirm the version in force on diariodarepublica.pt
verified.fonte_secundaria: article/number taken from an official summary or secondary source; the legal text itself not read yet
verified.nao_verificado: diploma known, article or number still to confirm

layer_state.loaded: in the local database for the study area
layer_state.pending: stage exists, waiting for an input (e.g. the DGT MDT tiles)
layer_state.planned: open source found (data/inventory.md), no loader stage yet — needs the author's go-ahead per tier
layer_state.live: read from an API at question time, never stored
layer_state.reference: manual reference geometry, not a layer
layer_state.not_open: no open data — the requirement is reported as not assessable
layer_state.partial: loaded for part of the study area only (`note` says where); elsewhere the requirement is not assessable

principles: Coverage first: every answer opens with how many requirements of the profile can be assessed with the loaded layers and names the ones that cannot.
Unknown is not free: a blocking layer that is missing for a cell makes it 'unknown', never suitable.

For national infrastructure (airport, rail corridor, large PV, logistics park) LEGAL regimes are measured and named with their procedure; they become exclusions only when the author validates one as absolute (status 'validado').
Ranking uses Pareto layers: first fewer LEGAL regimes touched / fewer hectares under them, then TECHNICAL scores; trade-offs are shown, not hidden in weights.
Proxies are named as proxies (e.g. residents under simplified approach surfaces are not a noise contour).

cos2023.what: land cover, level-4 classes (codes as in COS2023v1 field COS23_n4_C)

apa_arpsi.what: areas of potentially significant flood risk

ine_bgri2021.what: census subsections: residents (incl. age groups), buildings, dwellings

mdt_lidar2024.what: elevation, slope (%), aspect at 10 m from the DGT LiDAR 2024 MDT

cop_dem30.what: fallback relief (surface model, 25 m) where the MDT has no value

apa_perimetros_captacao.what: protection perimeters of drinking-water abstractions (immediate / intermediate / extended; with the Portaria)
apa_perimetros_captacao.note: licence not stated — never shown in the demo until confirmed; the SRUP CASAP family (CC BY 4.0) covers the groundwater perimeters

apa_massas_subterraneas.what: groundwater bodies (river-basin plans) with quantitative / chemical / overall status
apa_massas_subterraneas.note: licence not stated — never shown in the demo until confirmed

ip_ferrovia.what: national rail network in operation (IP; 24 segments in the study area)

ip_rede_rodoviaria.what: national road plan network: motorways, IP, IC, EN, ER, junction ramps, with built / under construction / planned (IP)

osm_rede.what: OSM roads (motorway … residential, track) and rail/metro/tram (network for travel time)
osm_rede.note: OSM completeness varies: absence is never evidence of absence

osm_energia.what: OSM power lines (line, minor_line, cable) and substations/plants
osm_energia.note: voltage tagged on ~98 % of lines; substations as points

eredes_capacidade_rececao.what: hosting capacity for new generation per HV/MV substation (MVA: regulated report, last quarter, forecast)
eredes_capacidade_rececao.note: no coordinates at the source: a point only where one OSM substation with the same name lies in that municipality (104 of 128 installations in the study area: HV/MV substations 92/112, switching posts 12/16); the rest are known by municipality only

eredes_ptd.what: MV/LV secondary substations (points, installed kVA, usage band)

lneg_paer.note: view-only: the LNEG service returns attributes but no geometry (2026-09-30) — the acceleration areas cannot be measured

lneg_menos_sensiveis.what: areas of lower environmental and heritage sensitivity for solar/wind, scenarios 1–4 (LNEG)
lneg_menos_sensiveis.source: data/sources.md (loaded 2026-09-30; licence: CC BY 4.0 on dados.gov.pt vs the LNEG geoPortal's non-commercial notice, found 2026-10-01)
lneg_menos_sensiveis.note: licence statements conflict — the stricter applies; off screen in the demo until the author decides; scenario 4 is the most restrictive (also without mapped RAN/REN)

lneg_geologia.what: geological map of Portugal 1:500 000 (LNEG, 5th edition 1992): lithostratigraphic units
lneg_geologia.note: regional reading only (0.5 mm = 250 m) — never a foundation fact for a plot; the AML 1:100 000 map is published as images only and the 1:200 000 continuous prototype does not cover the study area

ruido_municipal.note: Oeiras only; the Lisboa map is behind a JavaScript challenge (not scriptable, 2026-09-30) → noise unknown in the other 29 municipalities

equip_escolas.what: schools by level and nature (TML, AML) + OSM schools elsewhere
equip_escolas.source: data/sources.md (TML: ODbL per its repository; loaded 2026-09-30)
equip_escolas.note: TML covers the 18 AML municipalities; the Lezíria and Vendas Novas rely on OSM (osm_pois)

equip_saude.what: primary-care units (TML, AML) + OSM hospitals and clinics
equip_saude.source: data/sources.md (TML: ODbL per its repository; loaded 2026-09-30)
equip_saude.note: registered users per unit not loaded (the SNS dataset is aggregated per ACES); hospitals from OSM only

gtfs.what: public transport: Carris Metropolitana stops and route patterns, Metro de Lisboa stations and lines
gtfs.note: stops and routes only (AML + Metro); no timetables (the Carris Metropolitana GTFS has no stated licence) → distance to transit yes, transit travel time not yet

dgeg_centrais_solares.what: existing solar plants licensed or being licensed by DGEG (cumulative effect, 2 km rule)
dgeg_centrais_solares.source: data/sources.md (CC BY 4.0 on dados.gov.pt vs CC BY-NC 4.0 on the service — the stricter applies; loaded 2026-10-01)
dgeg_centrais_solares.note: parks, sub-parks and blocks as rows (114 rows, 59 licensing processes); empty operating licence = being licensed; park-level power and area repeat on every block row; owner not loaded

openmeteo_vento.what: hourly wind 10 m + gusts (ERA5 reanalysis), ~30 points

icnf_psrn2000.what: Natura 2000 sectoral plan habitats and species (birds)

ec8_zonamento.what: EC8 seismic zone per municipality (manual table)

cti_opcoes.what: the 9 CTI airport options digitised from PT2 Annex 12 layouts

af_tracados.what: high-speed rail route alternatives digitised from public maps

ruido_aeronaves_novos_locais.what: aircraft noise contours for new sites

osm_pois.what: OSM schools, health units (hospital, clinic, doctors) and stations (rail, metro, bus, ferry)
osm_pois.note: fallback where official lists do not cover; OSM completeness varies

eredes_carga_subestacao.what: HV/MV substation load: natural load, installed and guaranteed power, availability (MVA), winter and summer
eredes_carga_subestacao.note: headroom for LOAD at distribution level only — not the transmission grid; not yet bound to any requirement (author to decide for the data-centre profile)

asks.pt: Cabe a pegada (área, dimensões, orientações admitidas)?
asks.en: Does the footprint fit (area, dimensions, allowed orientations)?

primitives.measures: footprint fit over admissible cells (≥ 95 % admissible), per orientation
primitives.unknown_when: never — geometry only; depends on the other primitives for admissibility

asks.pt: O terreno é suficientemente plano para a pegada?
asks.en: Is the ground flat enough for the footprint?

primitives.measures: slope (%) share by class; elevation range along an axis; std of elevation (earthworks proxy)
primitives.unknown_when: MDT missing and fallback not loaded; the fallback is a surface model and is said as such

asks.pt: Há água, estuário ou tecido urbano contínuo onde a pegada não pode ir?
asks.en: Is there water, estuary or continuous urban fabric the footprint cannot go on?

primitives.measures: share of footprint in excluded COS classes

asks.pt: Que regimes toca, quantos hectares e que procedimento dispara cada um?
asks.en: Which regimes does it touch, how many hectares, and which procedure does each trigger?

primitives.measures: hectares (or length for corridors) per regime; diploma; procedure
primitives.unknown_when: a regime layer not loaded → that regime is 'not assessed', listed in coverage

asks.pt: O plano ou uma designação legal facilita este uso aqui?
asks.en: Does the plan or a legal designation make this use easier here?

primitives.measures: share of footprint in favourable CRUS categories or designated areas

asks.pt: A que distância fica da autoestrada, da ferrovia, da subestação?
asks.en: How far to the motorway, rail line, substation?

primitives.measures: straight-line distance (km) to the nearest feature of the network

asks.pt: Quanto tempo até ao destino que interessa (Lisboa, porto, escola)?
asks.en: How long to the destination that matters (Lisbon, port, school)?

primitives.measures: network travel time (road; transit where GTFS exists) — straight-line distance as the stated fallback
primitives.unknown_when: no network → straight-line distance only, said as such

asks.pt: Quantas pessoas serve, ou quantas ficam expostas?
asks.en: How many people does it serve, or expose?

primitives.measures: residents (and age groups) from BGRI subsections in a catchment or under a surface
primitives.unknown_when: never inside the study area (Censos 2021); the date is stated

asks.pt: Onde já existe o serviço (e onde falta)?
asks.en: Where does the service already exist (and where is it missing)?

primitives.measures: distance/time to the nearest existing unit; demand not covered
primitives.unknown_when: unit layer not loaded → gap reasoning impossible, stated

asks.pt: Cheia, incêndio, sismo, subida do mar?

primitives.measures: share of footprint per hazard class; history (burned areas)

asks.pt: O vento permite a orientação da pista? Quanta radiação solar?
asks.en: Does the wind allow the runway orientation? How much solar irradiation?

primitives.measures: crosswind usability per orientation (wind rose); GHI per point
primitives.unknown_when: no wind series → orientation not checked

asks.pt: Há capacidade para ligar (injetar) ou para consumir?
asks.en: Is there capacity to connect (inject) or to consume?

primitives.measures: published reception capacity (MW) at the nearest substations; consumption capacity is not open

asks.pt: O local excede os limites de ruído para usos sensíveis?
asks.en: Does the place exceed the noise limits for sensitive uses?

primitives.measures: Lden/Ln class from strategic noise maps
primitives.unknown_when: outside Lisboa and Oeiras (no open map)

primitives.measures: share of footprint per geological unit; overlap with groundwater bodies; nearby boreholes

asks.pt: Há água e fibra com a capacidade pedida?
asks.en: Is there water and fibre with the requested capacity?

primitives.measures: supply capacity and route distance — no open data today

rule.pt: Água e estuário: classes COS 9.* (cursos de água, lagos, albufeiras, salinas, lagoas costeiras, desembocaduras, oceano) e 8.1.2.1 sapais / 8.1.2.2 zonas entremarés → fora da pegada
rule.en: Water and estuary: COS classes 9.* and 8.1.2.1 salt marsh / 8.1.2.2 intertidal → outside the footprint

rules.source: physical infeasibility (site-selection.md §3); class codes from COS2023v1 (field COS23_n4_C, read 2026-09-30)

rule.pt: Tecido edificado residencial contínuo (COS 1.1.1.1 e 1.1.1.2) → fora da pegada de grandes infraestruturas; em corredores conta como custo (demolições)
rule.en: Continuous residential fabric (COS 1.1.1.1, 1.1.1.2) → outside large-infrastructure footprints; a cost for corridors

rules.source: physical/social infeasibility (site-selection.md §3); codes from COS2023v1

rule.pt: Camada bloqueante em falta numa célula → célula 'desconhecida', nunca admissível; entra na lista do que não foi avaliado
rule.en: Missing blocking layer for a cell → 'unknown', never admissible; listed in what was not assessed

rules.source: project rule 'unknown ≠ free' (docs/reasoning.md; site-selection.md §2)

rule.pt: Aeroporto com pista ≥ 2 100 m e vias para tráfego ferroviário de longo curso → AIA obrigatória
rule.en: Airport with runway ≥ 2,100 m and long-distance railway lines → EIA mandatory

rules.source: DL 151-B/2013 (RJAIA), Anexo I, n.º 7, alínea a)

rule.pt: «Áreas sensíveis» para os limiares da AIA = áreas protegidas (DL 142/2008), sítios Natura 2000/ZEC/ZPE (DL 140/99) e zonas de proteção de imóveis classificados ou em vias de classificação (Lei 107/2001) — decide que limiar do Anexo II se aplica
rule.en: 'Sensitive areas' for EIA thresholds = protected areas, Natura 2000 sites and heritage protection zones — decides which Annex II threshold applies

rules.source: DL 151-B/2013, art. 2.º, alínea a)

rule.pt: Central solar: AIA obrigatória se a área de painéis e inversores ≥ 100 ha (caso geral); em área sensível se ≥ 10 ha ou potência ≥ 20 MW; abaixo, análise caso a caso — excluída se área < 15 ha, sem outras centrais > 1 MW a menos de 2 km que somem ≥ 15 ha e ligação ≤ 60 kV com < 10 km
rule.en: Solar plant: EIA mandatory if panels+inverters area ≥ 100 ha (general case); in a sensitive area if ≥ 10 ha or ≥ 20 MW; below that case-by-case, waived if < 15 ha, no other > 1 MW plants within 2 km adding up to ≥ 15 ha and grid link ≤ 60 kV and < 10 km

rules.source: DL 151-B/2013, Anexo II, n.º 3, alínea a), i), na redação do DL 11/2023 (republicação do RJAIA no próprio DL 11/2023)
rules.verified: texto_oficial 2026-09-30 (DR 1.ª série n.º 30, 10 Fev 2023; os sinais ≥ perdem-se na extração do PDF — confirmar na leitura)

rule.pt: Parques industriais ≥ 20 ha, loteamentos industriais ≥ 20 ha, plataformas logísticas ≥ 15 ha → AIA obrigatória (mesmos limiares em área sensível); abaixo, análise caso a caso
rule.en: Industrial parks ≥ 20 ha, industrial allotments ≥ 20 ha, logistics platforms ≥ 15 ha → EIA mandatory (same in sensitive areas); below, case-by-case

rules.source: DL 151-B/2013, Anexo II, n.º 10, alínea a), na redação do DL 11/2023

rule.pt: Loteamento urbano ≥ 10 ha ou mais de 500 fogos → AIA obrigatória; em área sensível ≥ 2 ha; dispensado de caso a caso em zona urbana consolidada ou com < 2 ha
rule.en: Urban allotment ≥ 10 ha or more than 500 dwellings → EIA mandatory; ≥ 2 ha in a sensitive area; no case-by-case in consolidated urban areas or below 2 ha

rules.source: DL 151-B/2013, Anexo II, n.º 10, alínea b), na redação do DL 11/2023

rule.pt: Procedimento de análise ambiental de alternativas de corredores de infraestruturas lineares (seleção do corredor antes do projeto de execução); aplica-se, entre outros, a transporte público em corredor próprio — aplicação à alta velocidade é inferência a confirmar
rule.en: Environmental analysis of alternative corridors for linear infrastructure (corridor chosen before the detailed design); covers public transport on its own corridor — applying it to high-speed rail is an inference to confirm

rules.source: DL 151-B/2013, art. 31.º-A (aditado pelo DL 11/2023)

rule.pt: REN: usos compatíveis só os previstos no regime; fora deles, ação de relevante interesse público reconhecida por despacho quando não possa ser realizada fora da REN; para infraestruturas públicas (rodovia, ferrovia, porto, aeroporto, água) sujeitas a AIA, a DIA favorável equivale a esse reconhecimento
rule.en: REN: only uses allowed by the regime; otherwise an action of relevant public interest recognised by order when it cannot be done outside the REN; for public infrastructure subject to EIA a favourable EIA decision counts as that recognition

rules.source: DL 166/2008 (RJREN), arts. 20.º e 21.º (n.º exato da equivalência DIA a confirmar); art. 21.º, n.os 1–2 alterados pelo DL 129/2026, de 29 de junho (a confirmar)

rule.pt: RAN: utilizações não agrícolas só nos casos previstos, com parecer prévio da entidade regional da RAN; fora deles, ação de relevante interesse público reconhecida por despacho conjunto quando não possa ser realizada fora da RAN
rule.en: RAN: non-agricultural uses only in the listed cases, with the regional RAN body's prior opinion; otherwise relevant public interest by joint order when it cannot be done outside the RAN

rules.source: DL 73/2009 (RJRAN), arts. 22.º e 25.º

rule.pt: ZEC/ZPE: avaliação de incidências ambientais; com impacte negativo só se autoriza sem alternativas e por razões imperativas de reconhecido interesse público (despacho conjunto), com medidas compensatórias; habitat/espécie prioritários → só saúde/segurança pública, benefício ambiental primordial ou parecer prévio da Comissão Europeia
rule.en: ZEC/ZPE: appropriate assessment; with negative effects, only without alternatives and for imperative reasons of overriding public interest (joint order), with compensation; priority habitats/species → public health/safety, primary environmental benefit or prior Commission opinion

rules.source: DL 140/99, art. 10.º (redação do DL 49/2005); Diretiva 92/43/CEE, art. 6.º, n.os 3–4

rule.pt: Área protegida da RNAP (ex.: Reserva Natural do Estuário do Tejo): hectares dentro; o regulamento da própria área diz o que é interdito ou condicionado
rule.en: RNAP protected area (e.g. Tagus Estuary Nature Reserve): hectares inside; the area's own regulation says what is forbidden or conditioned

rules.source: DL 142/2008 (RJCNB) + regulamento/programa especial de cada área (campo diploma da camada)

rule.pt: Povoamentos de sobreiro ou azinheira: conversão proibida salvo empreendimentos de imprescindível utilidade pública ou agrícolas de relevante interesse (com compensação); a COS é proxy — a COS não delimita «povoamento» no sentido legal
rule.en: Cork-oak / holm-oak stands: conversion forbidden except for projects of indispensable public utility or qualifying farm projects (with compensation); COS is a proxy — it does not delimit a legal 'stand'

rules.source: DL 169/2001, art. 2.º (redação do DL 155/2004)

rule.pt: Classe/categoria do PDM na pegada: compatível → dizer; incompatível → alteração ou suspensão do plano (procedimento e prazo, não proibição)
rule.en: PDM class/category in the footprint: compatible → say so; incompatible → plan amendment or suspension (a procedure, not a ban)

rules.source: RJIGT, DL 80/2015 (alteração e suspensão de planos — artigos a confirmar); DR 15/2015 (classes e categorias)

rule.pt: Nas áreas prioritárias de prevenção e segurança (APPS) com condicionamentos, fora de aglomerados rurais, são interditos loteamentos e obras de edificação; exceção expressa para obras não habitacionais sem alternativa de localização (produção e armazenamento de energia, vias de comunicação, redes de energia e gás, telecomunicações). Proxy: classes alta/muito alta da carta de perigosidade de 2022 — as APPS não estão carregadas
rule.en: In priority prevention and safety areas (APPS) with building restrictions, outside rural settlements, allotments and building works are forbidden; express exception for non-residential works without an alternative location (energy production/storage, roads and rail, energy and gas networks, telecoms). Proxy: high/very high classes of the 2022 hazard map — APPS are not loaded

rules.source: DL 82/2021 (SGIFR), art. 60.º, n.º 1 e n.º 2, alínea c)
rules.verified: texto_consolidado 2026-09-30 (sgifr.gov.pt, versão de 14-7-2023; alterações posteriores não vistas)

rule.pt: Zona inundável T100 → edificação condicionada às normas do PGRI e do PDM
rule.en: T100 flood extent → building conditioned by the flood-risk plan and the PDM

rules.source: PGRI 2022–2027 e regulamento do PDM — norma aplicável a confirmar (igual a pretensoes.json cheia_t100)

rule.pt: Zonas sensíveis: Lden ≤ 55 dB(A) e Ln ≤ 45 dB(A) (mistas: 65/55); é interdito licenciar novos edifícios habitacionais, escolas, hospitais ou similares enquanto os limites forem excedidos, com exceção para habitação em zona urbana consolidada nas condições do n.º 7
rule.en: Sensitive zones: Lden ≤ 55 dB(A) and Ln ≤ 45 dB(A) (mixed: 65/55); new dwellings, schools, hospitals or similar cannot be licensed while limits are exceeded, with an exception for housing in consolidated urban areas under n.º 7

rules.source: DL 9/2007 (RGR), art. 11.º, n.º 1, alíneas a) e b); art. 12.º, n.os 6 e 7

rule.pt: Imóveis classificados ou em vias de classificação: zona geral de proteção de 50 m a partir dos limites externos, ou zona especial de proteção quando fixada → parecer da tutela do património
rule.en: Classified heritage (or under classification): 50 m general protection zone from its outer limits, or a special protection zone where set → heritage authority opinion

rule.pt: Domínio público hídrico: margem de 50 m (mar e águas navegáveis sob jurisdição marítima/portuária), 30 m (outras navegáveis ou flutuáveis), 10 m (não navegáveis) → título de utilização
rule.en: Public water domain: 50 m bank (sea and navigable waters under maritime/port jurisdiction), 30 m (other navigable/floatable), 10 m (non-navigable) → use permit

rule.pt: Perímetros de proteção de captações de água para abastecimento público (zonas imediata, intermédia, alargada) → atividades interditas ou condicionadas conforme a zona
rule.en: Protection perimeters of public-supply abstractions (immediate, intermediate, extended) → activities forbidden or conditioned by zone

rules.source: DL 382/99 (artigos a confirmar) + portaria de delimitação de cada perímetro

rule.pt: Servidões aeronáuticas existentes (ex.: Aeroporto de Lisboa) → alturas e usos condicionados, parecer da ANAC
rule.en: Existing aeronautical easements (e.g. Lisbon airport) → heights and uses conditioned, ANAC opinion

rules.source: DL 45987/1964 (regime geral das servidões aeronáuticas civis); Decreto 48542/1968 (Aeroporto de Lisboa) — lista da ANAC

rule.pt: Servidões militares e de defesa nacional (o Campo de Tiro de Alcochete ainda é área militar) → parecer da Defesa
rule.en: Military and defence easements (the Alcochete firing range is still military) → Defence opinion

rule.pt: Gasodutos/oleodutos, regime florestal, aproveitamentos hidroagrícolas → servidão com parecer da entidade; o diploma vem no registo SRUP de cada objeto
rule.en: Pipelines, forest regime, hydro-agricultural schemes → easement with the body's opinion; the diploma comes with each SRUP record

rules.source: diploma de cada servidão, lido do registo SRUP (DGT) quando a camada for carregada

rule.pt: Solo urbano (categorias habitacionais/centrais/mistas) → habitação admitida em princípio; solo rústico → só nas exceções do PDM
rule.en: Urban land (residential/central/mixed categories) → housing admitted in principle; rural land → only the PDM exceptions

rules.source: DR 15/2015 (classes e categorias de solo; artigos a confirmar) + regulamento do PDM

rule.pt: Categoria de espaços de atividades económicas (ou industriais/logísticos no PDM) → uso previsto no plano
rule.en: Economic-activity land category (or industrial/logistics in the PDM) → use foreseen by the plan

rules.source: DR 15/2015 (categorias do solo urbano; artigo a confirmar) + regulamento do PDM

rule.pt: Espaços de uso especial — equipamentos (ou reserva para equipamento no PDM) → uso previsto no plano
rule.en: Special-use land for public facilities (or a PDM reservation) → use foreseen by the plan

rules.source: DR 15/2015 (categorias do solo urbano; artigo a confirmar) + regulamento do PDM

rule.pt: Área de aceleração de renováveis (ou área menos sensível para solar) → licenciamento simplificado previsto; peso e efeito jurídico dependem da transposição nacional e do estado do PAER
rule.en: Renewable acceleration area (or less-sensitive area for solar) → simplified permitting foreseen; weight and legal effect depend on the national transposition and the PAER's status

rules.source: Diretiva (UE) 2023/2413 (RED III), art. 15.º-C da Diretiva 2018/2001 alterada; transposição nacional e estado do PAER (LNEG) a confirmar

rule.pt: Classes de declive de pretensoes.json (plano < 5 %, suave 5–10, moderado 10–15, acentuado 15–25, muito acentuado 25–35, escarpado > 35); o limiar por tipo está no perfil
rule.en: Slope classes from pretensoes.json; the per-type limit lives in the profile

rules.source: data/pretensoes.json slope_classes_pct

rule.pt: Share da pegada em perigosidade alta/muito alta e área ardida nos últimos 10 anos → pontua (para usos isentos do art. 60.º SGIFR é risco técnico, não interdição)
rule.en: Share of footprint in high/very high hazard and burned in the last 10 years → scored (for uses exempt from SGIFR art. 60 it is a technical risk, not a ban)

rules.source: classes da carta ICNF (data/sources.md); janela de 10 anos = escolha do projeto

rule.pt: Share da pegada em T100 e T1000 → pontua (cota máxima quando existe)
rule.en: Share of footprint in T100 and T1000 → scored (max water level where given)

rules.source: PGRI 2.º ciclo (APA)

rule.pt: Zona sísmica EC8 do concelho (ação tipo 1 e 2) → contexto de custo estrutural
rule.en: EC8 seismic zone of the municipality → structural cost context

rules.source: NP EN 1998-1, Anexo Nacional (tabela por concelho, a introduzir manualmente)

rule.pt: Share da pegada em aluviões/solos brandos e sobre massa de água subterrânea sensível (ex.: Tejo-Sado) → pontua (fundações, contaminação)

answer.pt: Consigo dizer onde não pode ser (regimes legais, cheias, incêndio, declive), mas não onde deve ser: os três requisitos decisivos — potência para consumo, água para arrefecimento e fibra — não têm dados abertos. Não ordeno candidatas.
answer.en: I can say where it cannot go (legal regimes, floods, fire, slope) but not where it should: the three decisive requirements — power for consumption, cooling water and fibre — have no open data. I do not rank candidates.
